title: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love

entities.name: Rankle, Master of Pranks
entities.description: A small, mischievous faerie with a bad wing who is thrown out by his friends, falls in love with Queen Ayara and tricks the Phyrexian horde into a chasm.

entities.name: Mags
entities.description: A clever, knife-wielding faerie with bat-like wings who leads the others in kicking Rankle out and tears his wing.

entities.name: Orla
entities.description: A faerie who helps trick Rankle; he once put bees in her mouth.

entities.name: Fifer
entities.description: A faerie who wears a dead rabbit as a hat and helps trick Rankle; Rankle once sewed his mouth shut.

entities.name: Chulane
entities.description: A white-haired storyteller who warns villagers and then Queen Ayara of coming evil.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: Queen of the Locthwain Court, fierce and cunning, who has outlived many husbands; she is later seen transformed by Phyrexia and marshaling its troops.

entities.name: Torbran
entities.description: A red-bearded dwarf with a magical golden wishing ring who needs the ring to lure the invaders into a chasm.

entities.name: The witch of Edgewall
entities.description: A witch who runs the charms shop in Edgewall, sends Rankle on a quest for a love flower and is leaving to join forces with others against the coming doom.

entities.name: Questing Beast
entities.description: A legendary beast that Rankle and Mags once made cry.

entities.name: The Piper
entities.description: A rat-catcher expected to have his work cut out for him with the swarming rats.

entities.name: The Kenriths
entities.description: The royal family of Eldraine's courts, said by Torbran to be gone.

entities.name: Locthwain Court
entities.description: The court of Queen Ayara, whose knights wear black and gold and are later transformed into Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading force of transformed knights, dogs and monstrosities that has overrun the courts of Eldraine.

entities.name: Locthwain Castle
entities.description: Queen Ayara's floating castle, which crashes to the ground and is transformed.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: A village that shows no sign of life, where Rankle finds the charm shop.

entities.name: Hero's Rock
entities.description: A rock at the crossroads outside the village where Chulane preaches.

entities.name: Undertaker's Corner
entities.description: A perilous cliffside section of road overlooking a grange.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The fairy tale plane that is being invaded.

entities.name: Garenbrig
entities.description: A place named in passing as far as Ayara's suitors come from.

entities.name: Wishing ring
entities.description: Torbran's magical golden ring that grants wishes, though not ones too powerful or far-reaching for the plane.

events.summary: Rankle's fellow faeries pretend to crown him, then trap him in a net and tell him nobody wants him there.
Rankle tries to attack when released; the faeries beat him and Mags pins and tears his wing, leaving him unable to fly.
Rankle is expelled from the glade and resolves to rob the first human he sees.
events.quote: He vowed to rob the first human that he saw.

events.summary: Chulane warns the villagers about the bruise-like sky and signs of evil, and they mock him and throw stones.
events.quote: "Something terrible is about to befall us!"

events.summary: Rankle follows Chulane and sees floating Locthwain Castle and Queen Ayara's procession.
events.quote: this was his first glimpse of the floating castle

events.summary: Chulane begs Queen Ayara for a word, and she invites him into her carriage to tell her everything.
events.quote: "Well, come inside and tell me everything."

events.summary: Rankle glimpses Ayara's face, is smitten, and decides he must become her next husband.
events.quote: He must become Ayara's next husband.

events.summary: Rankle goes to the charm shop in Edgewall, smashes potions and demands a love potion from the hidden witch.
events.quote: Rankle smashed the bottle on the floor.

events.summary: The witch freezes Rankle in mid-air, says she is leaving to join forces against the coming doom, and offers him a choice; he chooses the quest for a love flower.
events.quote: "We're joining forces to fight the doom that's coming."

events.summary: Rankle finds no flowers in the murky forest and heads back, nearly trampled by fleeing elk.
events.quote: a herd of elk burst out of the thicket and nearly trampled him

events.summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
events.quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

events.summary: Torbran tells Rankle the courts have fallen and that they must stand at Locthwain; Rankle sees this as a chance to reach Ayara.
events.quote: "The courts have fallen," the dwarf said in a quivery voice.

events.summary: Rankle transforms Torbran's ring into a caterpillar and steals it while he sleeps.
events.quote: The ring had transformed into a caterpillar.

events.summary: Rankle uses the ring to wish for a basket of cookies and then a love potion, refusing to return it.
events.quote: "I wish for a love potion!" Rankle interrupted.

events.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
events.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

events.summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
events.quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

events.summary: Lovestruck by the rain, the Phyrexian legions chase Rankle and pour over the edge into the chasm.
events.quote: Wave after wave followed him, pouring over the edge like lovestruck lemmings.

events.summary: A spell of many voices puts everyone in the chasm to sleep, and Rankle drifts down onto a throne of his fallen admirers.
events.quote: Rankle could see that everyone in the chasm had fallen into an unnatural sleep.

relations.note: Mags wants to gut him and expels him
relations.quote: "No, I just wanted to gut you," Mags clarified.

relations.note: Orla resents his bee prank and helps cast him out
relations.quote: "You put bees in my mouth when I was sleeping," Orla said.

relations.note: Fifer resents having his mouth sewn shut
relations.quote: "You sewed my mouth shut," Fifer reminded him.
Queen Ayara reigned over the Locthwain Court

relations.note: Rankle is smitten with Ayara, who does not know him
relations.quote: But Rankle took no notice of this, for he was smitten .

relations.note: Torbran argues their kind must work together
relations.quote: Our kind is meant to work together.

relations.note: Torbran fights the invaders and lays a trap for them
relations.quote: We have laid a trap for these monsters.

relations.note: Torbran owns the ring; the page does not say who made it
The floating castle of Locthwain stands in Eldraine
relations.quote: How can you not weep for what Eldraine has become?

relations.note: Transformed Ayara commands the Phyrexian troops in a harsh language
relations.quote: as she marshaled her troops in a harsh, unfamiliar language
